item: Row 292 (R776): the place gazetteer states the last applied daily OSM file's date beside the extract's
summary: The build read osm_objects after any daily files but dated the artifact by the extract alone. It now takes each country's data date from country_data_date: countries[].last_diff (the last contiguous file's own date, or not-read), as_of = oldest extract + newest file (extract+date or extract+not-read), each entry dated by its own country (artifact-wide when its country has no record). The place card shows both dates in R775's words, no new strings. Nothing applied: byte-identical artifact; a gazetteer built before R776 reads as before. No egress, no schema change.
